description: Carmacks flood hazard maps is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Yukon | Gouvernement du Yukon. The Carmacks flood hazard mapping study was completed between April 2023 and May 2024. Learn more by visiting the Yukon Flood Hub. In the Resources section below, you can find the project summary, technical report, "What We Heard" report, GIS data files, and flood maps for specific areas. Coverage: Government of Yukon. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Yukon | Gouvernement du Yukon. Its tags are flood-hub, flood-mapping, flood-maps, flooding, Government information. It offers 12 resource(s) in FGDB/GDB, HTML, PDF, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Yukon. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
